title: 第5章 镖局考核，根骨测试
novel_title: 莫欺老年穷，一天增加一个天赋点
content_zh:
陈安的目光扫过门外一张张年轻而充满渴望的脸庞，古井无波的心湖，泛起了一丝极其细微的涟漪。

    六十年前，他也是他们中的一员。

    就在人群的喧闹声愈发嘈杂之际，一道精悍的身影从院内大步走出。

    来人约莫四十岁，一身镖局高级镖师的劲装，太阳穴高高鼓起，行走间龙行虎步，一股凌厉的气势自然散发。

    陈安心中一动，认得此人。

    风云镖局总镖头之一，王铁，货真价实的九品武者！

    在风云镖局内，总共分为镖师和总镖头，以及秦虎这位大当家。

    镖师都是开始淬炼气血的准武者，至于总镖头……更是货真价实的九品武者！

    “都静一静！”

    王铁声如洪钟，仅仅两个字，就压下了门外所有的议论声。

    他锐利的目光扫过全场，沉声道：“风云镖局，将于一月之后，在此地公开招收趟子手与学徒。有志者，一月后再来，不必日日在此等候，徒耗光阴！”

    话音落下，人群中一阵骚动，虽有不甘，但在一位九品武者那如山岳般的气势压迫下，无人敢于造次，只能三三两两地悻悻散去。

    王铁见状，满意地点了点头，转身正欲返回。可当他的目光落在门边静立的陈安身上时，那张严肃冷峻的脸庞瞬间一变，快走两步，竟对着陈安恭恭敬敬地抱拳躬身。

    “陈叔，您老辛苦了。当家的吩咐过，您只管开门，其余杂事，我们来做。”

    这突如其来的一幕，让几个还未走远的年轻人瞬间定在原地，眼珠子都快瞪了出来。

    那可是风云镖局的总镖头！

    九品武者！

    竟对一个看门的老头如此恭敬？

    这老头，到底什么来头？

    几人面面相觑，再看陈安时，眼神中已没了之前的轻视，取而代之的是深深的敬畏与猜测。

    陈安对此仿佛毫无所觉，只是平静地点了点头，算是回应。

    他缓缓拉上大门，将外界所有的喧嚣与探究，尽数隔绝。

    “吱呀……”

    厚重的门板合拢，门内门外，两个世界。

    陈安转身，看向空旷的演武场，浑浊的双眸中，一抹谁也未曾察觉的精光一闪而过。

    “一个月么……”

    “一个月之后风云镖局招揽有志之士，按照惯例是会传授他们武道功法的，或许……”

    陈安内心微微一动，旋即朝着小木屋的方向走去。

    ……

    时间，开始以一种近乎疯狂的节奏飞速流逝。
content_en:
Chen An's eyes swept across the young and longing faces outside the door, and an extremely small ripple appeared in Gu Jing's calm heart.

    Sixty years ago, he was one of them.

    Just as the noise of the crowd became more and more noisy, a strong figure strode out of the courtyard.

    The visitor was about forty years old. He was dressed in the attire of a senior escort from the escort agency. His temples were bulging high. He walked with the strides of a dragon and a tiger, and he naturally exuded a fierce aura.

    Chen An's heart moved and he recognized this person.

    One of the chief escorts of Fengyun Escort Bureau, Wang Tie, is a genuine ninth-grade warrior!

    Within the Fengyun Escort Bureau, there are a total of three categories: the Escort Master, the Chief Escort Chief, and Qin Hu, the head of the Escort Bureau.

    The escort masters are all quasi-warriors who have begun to temper their Qi and blood. As for the chief escort... they are genuine ninth-grade warriors!

    "Everyone, be quiet!"

    Wang Tie's voice was like a bell. Just two words silenced all the discussions outside the door.

    His sharp gaze swept over the entire audience, and he said in a deep voice: "Fengyun Escort Bureau will openly recruit agents and apprentices here after one month. Those who are interested can come back after one month. There is no need to waste time waiting here!"

    After the words fell, there was a commotion in the crowd. Although they were unwilling to accept it, under the pressure of the mountain-like aura of a ninth-grade warrior, no one dared to make a mistake and could only disperse in twos and threes.

    Seeing this, Wang Tie nodded with satisfaction, turned around and was about to return. But when his eyes fell on Chen An, who was standing quietly by the door, his serious and cold face changed instantly. He took two quick steps and bowed respectfully to Chen An with clasped fists.

    "Uncle Chen, thank you for your hard work. The head of the house has told you to just open the door and we will do the rest."

    This sudden scene made several young people who had not gone far freeze in place instantly, their eyes almost bulging out of their sockets.

    That's the chief escort of Fengyun Escort Agency!

    Ninth-grade warrior!

    How could he be so respectful to an old gatekeeper?

    What is the origin of this old man?

    Several people looked at each other in confusion. When they looked at Chen An again, the contempt in their eyes was gone, replaced by deep awe and speculation.

    Chen An seemed unaware of this and just nodded calmly in response.

    He slowly closed the door, blocking out all the noise and inquiry from the outside world.

    "Squeak..."

    The heavy door panels are closed, and there are two worlds inside and outside the door.

    Chen An turned around and looked at the empty martial arts arena. In his cloudy eyes, a glimmer of light that no one had noticed flashed through.

    "One month..."

    "In a month, Fengyun Escort Bureau will recruit people with lofty ideals. As usual, they will teach them martial arts skills. Maybe..."

    Chen An's heart moved slightly, and he immediately walked towards the cabin.

    …

    Time began to pass at an almost crazy pace.
title_en: Chapter 5 Escort Bureau Assessment, Basic Test
